releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## 更新内容 / What's changed ### 修复 / Fixed - 移除了一处对 Obsidian 1.13 才有的接口的调用。实际执行路径从未走到它，所以没有人遇到过问题，但插件不该引用高于自己 `minAppVersion` 的 API。设置页在新旧版本上的行为都不变。
Removed a call into an API that only exists in Obsidian 1.13. Nothing ever reached it, so nobody hit a problem, but a plugin should not reference an API newer than its own `minAppVersion`. The settings tab behaves the same on every version. **Full changelog:** [`1.0.4...1.0.5`](https://github.com/PHANTOM-Nw/obsidian-mindmap-mode/compare/1.0.4...1.0.5) ## 安装 / Install **手动安装：** 把下方的 `main.js`、`manifest.json`、`styles.css` 下载到 ``` /.obsidian/plugins/mindmap-mode/ ``` 然后在 *设置 → 第三方插件* 中启用 **Mindmap Mode**。 （或者下载 `mindmap-mode.zip`，解压到 `.obsidian/plugins/` 下，一个文件搞定。） **BRAT：** 把 `PHANTOM-Nw/obsidian-mindmap-mode` 添加为 beta 插件。 **Manual:** download `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below into the folder above, then enable **Mindmap Mode** in *Settings → Community plugins*. (Or download `mindmap-mode.zip` and unzip it into `.obsidian/plugins/` -- one download instead of three.) **BRAT:** add `PHANTOM-Nw/obsidian-mindmap-mode` as a beta plugin. ## 用法 / Use it 打开一篇笔记，在命令面板里运行 **Toggle mind map view** —— 给它绑一个快捷键， 用起来就像切换阅读模式。导图在同一个标签页、同一个文件上打开，不会创建任何文件。 Open a note and run **Toggle mind map view** from the command palette — assign it a hotkey to make it feel like switching reading mode. The map opens in the same tab, on the same file. No files are ever created. Built from `1.0.5` with tests and typecheck passing.

releases.description:
## Install

**Manual:** download `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below into

```
<your vault>/.obsidian/plugins/mindmap-mode/
```

then enable **Mindmap Mode** in *Settings → Community plugins*.
(Or download `mindmap-mode.zip` and unzip it into `.obsidian/plugins/`.)

**BRAT:** add `PHANTOM-Nw/obsidian-mindmap-mode` as a beta plugin.

## Use it

Open a note and run **Toggle mind map view** from the command palette —
assign it a hotkey to make it feel like switching reading mode. The map
opens in the same tab, on the same file. No files are ever created.

Built from `1.0.1` with tests and typecheck passing.
